questions.q: What does the Sales Director's territory page need to show?
options: How a selected territory's sales compare to the company as a whole
A list of individual customer names
Product inventory by territory
A forecast of next year's territory growth
questions.explain: This is a benchmark view, not just a raw per-territory number.

questions.q: What does the benchmark table show, with DimTerritory[TerritoryName] on rows?
options: Total Sales, Pct of Company Total (Territory), and Order Count for every territory at once
Only CustomerSegment values
A single company-wide total with no breakdown
Product names and prices
questions.explain: The table benchmarks every territory against the company total in one view.

questions.q: Why is this page built at a faster, less careful pace than Lesson 10's page?
options: The Fields pane now has five similarly-named 'Total Sales' measures, making a wrong drag-and-drop an easy, ordinary mistake at this pace
Power BI technically requires faster building for territory pages
DimTerritory has fewer rows than DimCustomer
The headline card cannot be built carefully no matter the pace
questions.explain: This sets up the realistic field-binding mistake the lesson deliberately leaves unchecked for now.

questions.q: Why might the headline card look correct immediately after building it, even if it's mis-bound?
options: With no territory filter applied yet, every 'Total Sales' measure returns the same number, masking the mistake
Power BI automatically validates every card binding on creation
The headline card cannot be mis-bound by design
Mis-bound cards always show a visible error icon
questions.explain: This is the same ALL-has-nothing-to-strip-away detail from Lesson 9, now live and hiding a real mistake.

questions.q: What does this lesson deliberately leave unchecked, to be picked up in Lesson 13/14?
options: Clicking the headline card's Fields-pane binding to verify which exact measure it uses
Whether the table visual loads any data at all
Whether the territory slicer exists
Whether DimTerritory has a TerritoryGroup column
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly defers checking the headline card's binding, setting up the later debugging lessons.
